verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own docs say its first-party MCP server lets AI coding assistants "generate infrastructure code", and that Neo accepts plain-English requests and executes changes. Agent Skills teach assistants Pulumi workflows. However, code generation runs through external coding agents connected to the MCP server rather than a natively built-in generator, and Neo's plain-English flow is described as executing changes, not explicitly as emitting code. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language-to-code generation native to the CLI/toolchain, detail on generated code output (languages, quality, review flow), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate infrastructure code from natural language using AI assistance built into the toolchain

citations.quote: The Pulumi Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI-powered coding assistants to access your Pulumi Cloud resources, generate infrastructure code, and optionally delegate tasks to Pulumi Neo.
Tell Neo what you need in plain English. It handles dependencies, executes changes, and monitors outcomes automatically.
Pulumi Agent Skills are knowledge packages that teach AI coding assistants domain-specific Pulumi workflows.
